phase: Phase 1A — freeze the per-metric definition row schema. Design-only: NO metric rows are authored here; this is the contract every future SW-001..SW-295 row must satisfy.

business_question.note: Exact management/business question this metric answers.

null_missing_behavior.note: Explicit missing/null handling; missing is never silently zero.

denominator.note: Ambiguous/undefined denominator is a fail-closed stop.

formula.note: No calculated claim without a complete formula AND direct source fields.

required_fields.measurable_definition: measurable := disposition in ['measured_validated','data_acquired_calculation_pending'] OR evaluation_state in ['measured_unscored','measured_graded','measured_abstained']. Source-dependent fields (direct_source_fields, numerator, denominator, formula, zero_denominator_behavior) are required only when measurable; population/unit/polarity/window/calculation_kind/null_missing_behavior and the 3 subcontracts are ALWAYS required (a metric definition is fully specified even while its source existence is pending).

protected_content.note: true => requires the authorized protected-content envelope; may only be measured_abstained/measured_unscored until enveloped.

source_dependency_ids.note: References into the source registry/DAG (family-level), never per-metric duplicate acquisition.

review_point.note: Date/condition when a pending disposition is re-adjudicated.

finite_investigation_ref.note: Reference to the finite investigation packet (one help-contract pass, one read-only UI pass, one controlled probe). Required for source_investigation_pending; next_action alone is insufficient.

affirmative_investigation_evidence_ref.note: Affirmative source/retention/product evidence that the required event/field/history is not obtainable. Required to assert genuinely_not_available.

explainability_ref.note: How the data was used (objective hook: PE-grade + blue-collar readable).

evidence_index_ref.note: Hook into the deep supporting-data index over the 200+/295 metrics (active objective).

threshold_contract.purpose: Detection rule threshold — decides whether a Watchdog condition/event fires. Alerts evaluate ONLY this. Never silently changed by a comparison reference.

comparison_contract.purpose: Comparison reference — historical/capability/industry/peer context. Reference-only unless separately approved as the grade target. Multiple may be shown; never scores by itself.

grade_target_contract.purpose: The ONE approved standard used to score a gradable metric. Report grades use only this. Event/control metrics may be gradable=false with no grade target.

cross_field_invariants: All always_required_fields must be present and well-typed; missing any one is a fail-closed contract error.
calculation_kind drives conditional required fields per frozen-vocabularies.calculation_kind.required_fields_by_kind (e.g. rate => numerator, denominator, formula, zero_denominator_behavior).
boundary_class != 'sales' => customer_visibility != 'full' AND gradable == false AND evaluation_state in ['not_measured','measured_unscored'] (disposition-only).
metric_id in service_overlay_ids => boundary_class == 'separate_serra_service' AND customer_visibility == 'appendix_id_label_only'.

evaluation_state == 'measured_graded' => gradable == true AND disposition == 'measured_validated' AND grade_target_contract.approval_state=='approved' AND grade_target_contract.status=='active' AND grade_target_contract.compatibility_result=='compatible' AND numerator/denominator/formula(as required by calculation_kind)/unit/window present.
gradable == false => evaluation_state may be 'measured_unscored' at most; no grade_target may score it.

disposition == 'source_investigation_pending' => gradable==false AND customer_visibility!='full' AND owner,next_action,review_point,evidence_as_of,finite_investigation_ref present AND source_existence_state in ['unproved','investigation_pending'].

protected_content == true => sensitivity_class == 'protected_content' AND (evaluation_state in ['not_measured','measured_unscored','measured_abstained']) until protected-content envelope authorization is recorded.

detection_threshold_contract, comparison_reference_contract, grade_target_contract are THREE separate, always-present, independently versioned objects with DISTINCT ids (threshold_id != reference_id != grade_target_id); a change in one MUST NOT mutate another; each fully validates against its sub-contract required_fields.
no substitute/inferred value may be used to hide an absent direct field (missing is not zero).
